sackoverlay.ui.title: Sacks
sackoverlay.ui.empty: No items in your sacks yet.
sackoverlay.config.title: Sack Overlay
sackoverlay.config.searchMode.desc:
Filter: hide items that don't match, and pages without any match.
Dim: keep every page in place and grey out the items that don't match.
sackoverlay.config.rememberSearch.desc: Keep the last search when the screen is opened again.
sackoverlay.config.rememberScroll.desc: Reopen the pages where you left them.
sackoverlay.config.group.withdraw.desc: Clicking an item in a page sends /gfs, exactly as if you typed it. Nothing is ever sent without a click.
sackoverlay.config.replaceSackScreen: Replace the Sack of Sacks screen
sackoverlay.config.replaceSackScreen.des: Show Sack Overlay instead of the vanilla menu when you open /sacks. When disabled, /sackoverlay still opens it.
sackoverlay.config.theme.desc:
Transparent: dark and slightly see-through.
Light: light grey, like vanilla menus.
Dark: opaque dark grey.
sackoverlay.config.displayMode.desc:
Hypixel: every item a sack accepts, in the in-game order, with missing ones greyed out.
Compact: only the items you own, each shown once.
sackoverlay.config.itemOrder.desc:
Logical: inside each sack, items are grouped by where they come from, lower tiers first, compressed forms next to their base (all shark teeth together, for example).
Hypixel: the order of Hypixel's menus, mostly alphabetical.
sackoverlay.config.maxColumns.desc: Upper limit on side-by-side sack pages. Fewer are used when the screen is too narrow.
sackoverlay.config.glintRefresh.desc: Enchanted items are fully redrawn every frame by the game, which costs a lot of FPS with many of them on screen. Updating their shimmer less often gives a big FPS gain. Smooth keeps the game's behaviour.
sackoverlay.config.cachePages.desc: Draw the pages once and reuse them while nothing changes, instead of rebuilding them every frame. Big FPS gain. Turn it off if a page looks out of date or broken.
sackoverlay.config.resetPageOrder.desc: Drag a page by its title to move it. This puts every page back in the Sack of Sacks order.
sackoverlay.config.group.hiddenPages.des: Tick a sack to hide its page. Hidden pages still show up while searching, so their items can be found.
sackoverlay.config.instantUpdates.desc: Update amounts as soon as you withdraw or insert items, instead of waiting for Hypixel's [Sacks] message.
sackoverlay.config.leftClickFillsInvento: Ask for everything you own; Hypixel only moves what fits in your inventory.
sackoverlay.config.leftClickAmount.desc: Used when "Left click fills inventory" is off.
sackoverlay.config.withdrawDelayMs.desc: Hypixel handles /gfs slower than menu clicks. At most one /gfs is sent per delay; clicks in between add up and leave as one command, and the slot fills up while it waits.
